# ForgeSworn

> Open-source libraries, tools and self-hosted apps for Nostr, Lightning, cryptography, QR codes, storage, live media and private coordination. This index helps developers and coding assistants find the ForgeSworn component that fits their task.

Start with the task and target runtime below. Follow the project’s documentation for install commands, API examples and supported versions. Use the release documentation for the version you intend to integrate.

## Source and catalogue

- [ForgeSworn on GitHub](https://github.com/forgesworn): Canonical public repositories and the organisation’s project overview.
- [Project catalogue](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/forgesworn/.github/main/forgesworn-repos.json): Machine-readable repository links, package names where listed, categories and relationships.
- [Integration use cases](https://forgesworn.dev/use-cases.html): Workflows showing how multiple ForgeSworn projects fit together.
- [Ecosystem map](https://forgesworn.dev/map/ecosystem-map.svg): Visual map of the repositories.

## QR codes, invitations and pairing

- [ForgeSworn QR](https://forgesworn.github.io/qr/distribution.html): Generate or decode QR Code Model 2 locally. Use `@forgesworn/qr` on npm or JSR for TypeScript and optional WASM, `forgesworn-qr` for Rust, `forgesworn-qr-embedded` for allocation-free embedded encoding, or `io.github.forgesworn:qr` for Kotlin/JVM.
- [nostr-contact-card](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-contact-card): Encode signed ephemeral Nostr contact cards for sharing by link or QR. npm `nostr-contact-card`.
- [foregather-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/foregather-kit): Transfer portable invitations and verify a pairing with spoken checks. Consult the Rust/WASM integration and experimental live-pairing scope.
- [friend-link-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/friend-link-kit): Encode game invites and their encrypted hello packets in Rust. The caller supplies networking.

## Nostr identity, signing and trust

- [signet-login](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-login): Add sign-in without a password to a website or app: visitors use the Signet app on this device or scan a QR code with their phone, or bring a Nostr browser extension or remote signer. npm `signet-login`. Verify the login proof on your server.
- [signet-verify](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-verify): Verify Signet age credentials in a browser integration. npm `signet-verify`.
- [Signet Protocol](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet): Implement Signet auth and identity events. npm `signet-protocol`. See [signet-protocol-rs](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-protocol-rs) for the supported Rust wire surface.
- [nsec-tree](https://github.com/forgesworn/nsec-tree): Derive deterministic Nostr personas from one master secret. npm `nsec-tree`. See [nsec-tree-py](https://github.com/forgesworn/nsec-tree-py) for Python and [nsec-tree-cli](https://github.com/forgesworn/nsec-tree-cli) for command-line use.
- [signet-nip46-client](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-nip46-client): Pair a native Rust app with a NIP-46 remote signer.
- [Heartwood](https://github.com/forgesworn/heartwood): Run a keyless bridge to a supported hardware signer. See [Bark](https://github.com/forgesworn/bark) for browser signing and [Cambium](https://github.com/forgesworn/cambium) for Android NIP-55.
- [Signet Contacts](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-contacts): Request capability-scoped access to a Signet contact directory. See the [Kotlin implementation](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-contacts-kotlin), [Rust consumer](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-contacts-rs) and [shared vectors](https://github.com/forgesworn/signet-contacts-conformance).
- [kenspeckle](https://github.com/forgesworn/kenspeckle): Store verified relationships in a user-owned graph. npm `@forgesworn/kenspeckle` replaces the former Kindred package.
- [nostr-veil](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-veil): Build anonymous trust assertions using LSAG ring signatures. npm `nostr-veil`.
- [nostr-anon-vote](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-anon-vote): Build Nostr voting with anonymous group membership proofs. npm `nostr-anon-vote`.
- [spoken-token](https://github.com/forgesworn/spoken-token): Derive rotating words for human verification. npm `spoken-token`.
- [canary-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/canary-kit): Add a spoken verification flow with duress signalling and group sync. npm `canary-kit`.

## Lightning payments and paid APIs

- [toll-booth](https://github.com/forgesworn/toll-booth): Add HTTP payment gating to a TypeScript service. npm `@forgesworn/toll-booth`. Use [toll-booth-rs](https://github.com/forgesworn/toll-booth-rs) for L402 middleware in Rust.
- [402-mcp](https://github.com/forgesworn/402-mcp): Let an MCP client discover, pay for and call supported paid APIs. npm `402-mcp`. Pair with [402.pub](https://402.pub) for the public directory and [402-announce](https://github.com/forgesworn/402-announce) for service announcements.
- [nwc-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/nwc-kit): Connect a TypeScript application to a NIP-47 Nostr Wallet Connect service. npm `@forgesworn/nwc-kit`. See [nwc-lnd-bridge](https://github.com/forgesworn/nwc-lnd-bridge) to operate a wallet service backed by LND.
- [farrier-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/farrier-kit): Decode BOLT-11 invoices, check preimages and resolve LNURL-pay or Lightning Addresses. npm `farrier-kit`.
- [notecase](https://github.com/forgesworn/notecase): Implement or run an LNURLcash bearer-note wallet. npm `@forgesworn/notecase`.
- [moneyer](https://github.com/forgesworn/moneyer): Run or integrate the matching LNURLcash mint. npm `@forgesworn/moneyer`.

## Private groups, location and offline mesh

- [dominion](https://github.com/forgesworn/dominion): Encrypt content for tiered audiences with epoch rotation. npm `dominion-protocol`.
- [fold-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/fold-kit): Compose private Nostr room membership and epoch-key primitives.
- [covey-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/covey-kit): Build private circles and manage membership and epoch keys. See [roost-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/roost-kit) for private Nostr transport.
- [nostr-deaddrop](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-deaddrop): Use rendezvous keys for Nostr gift-wrap delivery. npm `nostr-deaddrop`. Review the metadata threat model for your relay and network.
- [flock-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/flock-kit): Add opt-in encrypted location sharing for trusted adult circles. See the [Flock source and release instructions](https://github.com/forgesworn/flock) for the app.
- [geohash-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/geohash-kit): Encode geohashes, query their neighbours and calculate coverage in TypeScript. npm `geohash-kit`.
- [rendezvous-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/rendezvous-kit): Find fair meeting points using travel-time isochrones and venue search. npm `rendezvous-kit`. An [MCP wrapper](https://github.com/forgesworn/rendezvous-mcp) is available.
- [mesh-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/mesh-kit): Build offline mesh messaging logic in TypeScript. See [mesh-nostr-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/mesh-nostr-kit) for the Nostr adapter and [capacitor-mesh-ble](https://github.com/forgesworn/capacitor-mesh-ble) for the native BLE transport.
- [Kintrinsic](https://github.com/forgesworn/kintrinsic): Integrate family-signed wardship rules with the consumer SDK `@forgesworn/charter`.

## Cryptographic building blocks

- [ring-sig](https://github.com/forgesworn/ring-sig): Create SAG and LSAG ring signatures over secp256k1. npm `@forgesworn/ring-sig`.
- [range-proof](https://github.com/forgesworn/range-proof): Prove a committed value lies in a range. npm `@forgesworn/range-proof`.
- [shamir-core](https://github.com/forgesworn/shamir-core): Split and recover byte secrets with a threshold of shares. npm `@forgesworn/shamir-core`.
- [shamir-words](https://github.com/forgesworn/shamir-words): Encode recovery shares as human-readable words. npm `@forgesworn/shamir-words`.
- [private-equality](https://github.com/forgesworn/private-equality): Check whether two parties hold the same secret using the Socialist Millionaires’ Protocol. npm `@forgesworn/private-equality`.
- [VMLS/1 codecs](https://github.com/forgesworn/vmls-core): Parse and verify the application wire wrapped around MLS in VMLS/1. Use a separate MLS engine for the group protocol.

## Self-hosted storage, networking and media

- [shelter-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/shelter-kit): Embed transport-neutral Blossom storage, retention and replication primitives in Rust.
- [Wildbloom Node](https://github.com/forgesworn/wildbloom-node): Operate a self-hosted Blossom node. [Wildbloom](https://wildbloom.forgesworn.dev/) is the companion browser app for encrypted storage pools.
- [ForgeSworn Link](https://github.com/forgesworn/forgesworn-link): Evaluate encrypted direct and relayed transport or blob replication between paired peers. Check the selected routing mode and platform support in the source docs.
- [Wok](https://github.com/forgesworn/wok): Embed a Rust Nostr store and WebSocket handling, or run the standalone members-only relay.
- [Sapflow](https://github.com/forgesworn/sapflow): Ingest SRT or RTMP, produce Low-Latency HLS and optionally record. See the Rust crate and server installation paths, and the qualification scope.
- [RelaySwarm](https://github.com/forgesworn/relayswarm): Add experimental peer-assisted HLS to an hls.js player with WebRTC, Nostr rendezvous and HTTP fallback. Use project release artefacts or source as documented. See [RelaySwarmKit](https://github.com/forgesworn/relayswarm-kit) for Swift signalling.
- [Spry TURN](https://github.com/forgesworn/spry-turn): Run a standalone Rust STUN/TURN relay or embed its native relay. Check the documented feature matrix, prereleases and deployment scope.
- [KithMoot](https://github.com/forgesworn/kithmoot): Run or integrate private Nostr rooms with chat, files and calls. See [KithMoot Android](https://github.com/forgesworn/kithmoot-android) for the Kotlin implementation and [ForgeSworn Node](https://github.com/forgesworn/forgesworn-node) for self-hosted services.
- [Fray](https://github.com/forgesworn/fray): Build a small realtime multiplayer game with Rust transport and session primitives. Use the starter and check current seat limits and supported paths.

## Developer tools and interoperability

- [Bray](https://github.com/forgesworn/bray): Use a Nostr CLI, TypeScript SDK or MCP server for identity, social, payment and trust workflows. npm `nostr-bray`.
- [Z1P Core](https://github.com/forgesworn/context/blob/main/docs/GETTING-STARTED.md): Give Claude Code or Codex local code graphs and bounded source evidence through MCP.
- [Quench](https://github.com/forgesworn/quench): Inspect local Claude Code and Codex usage and spending.
- [Anvil](https://github.com/forgesworn/anvil): Set up reproducible npm release builds with trusted publishing and provenance.
- [nostr-release-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/nostr-release-kit): Publish and verify signed sideloaded Android release announcements.
- [gopherkind](https://github.com/forgesworn/gopherkind): Serve signed Nostr documents over Gopher, Gemini or HTTP. npm `gopherkind`. See [gopherkind-protocol-py](https://github.com/forgesworn/gopherkind-protocol-py) for Python wire handling.
- [jurisdiction-kit](https://github.com/forgesworn/jurisdiction-kit): Read curated jurisdiction metadata from a static TypeScript dataset. npm `jurisdiction-kit`.
- [NIP drafts](https://github.com/forgesworn/nip-drafts): Review ForgeSworn’s proposed protocol extensions and their current status.
- [TROTT conformance](https://github.com/forgesworn/trott-conformance): Check a TROTT implementation against shared vectors.

## Optional

- [ForgeSworn products](https://forgesworn.dev/): Browse the app directory, including My Signet, Flock, DonkeyRide and Wildbloom.
- [Live media integration guide](https://forgesworn.dev/live-media.html): Compose a Sapflow origin, RelaySwarm delivery and optional Spry TURN.
- [Live media benchmarks](https://forgesworn.dev/live-media-benchmarks.html): Methods, versions and raw results for the live media stack.
- [Listening room and playback evidence](https://forgesworn.dev/llms-media.txt): Detailed media-demo notes and dated qualification runs.
- [Sponsor ForgeSworn](https://github.com/sponsors/TheCryptoDonkey): Support the projects. The public ForgeSworn Nostr address is `_@forgesworn.dev`.
